stock.description: Operating as an investment holding entity, Bright Future Technology Holdings Limited specializes in delivering advanced marketing solutions throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's diverse services encompass strategic influencer outreach for advertisers, sophisticated livestreaming capabilities tailored for merchants, along with targeted promotional strategies, AI-powered content creation, and mobile advertisement dissemination. Additionally, it offers various software-as-a-service (SaaS) subscription packages. Established in 2015 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, Bright Future Technology Holdings Limited operates as a division of Brilliant League Limited.
